normal.text: #gamer #artsy So, money is super tight this year, so I’m looking for ways to make little custom things to make the gaming life easier for my RL group. So after buying a bunch of character folios from Ultra-Pro that were on sale, I’m going “How can I make this more awesome?” One of the things my constant consumption of YouTube ttrpg media does is expose me to some ideas, and Mike Ponder, doing a game for the CDProject Red crew introduced standee’s from Monster fight club. normal.text: Retro RPG thought for a Monday evening: Planescape: Torment (1999) lets you talk your way past most of its fights, the final one included. Most games treat conversation as the bit between battles. Torment treats it as the battle. Which old game first made you realise words could be the weapon? #RetroGaming #RPG
